bucket_note: WVDOT's crash database (ReportBeam reports) is by email request only; no agency open layer or download. Verified live 2026-11-08 incl. WVDOT's ArcGIS Online org and its ArcGIS server.

placement_sample.note: not measured: no open record-level WVDOT data; the consultant layer (297 fatal/serious pedestrian crashes, 288 = 97.0% with lat/lon) is not a source and too narrow to stand for all crashes

blockers: WVDOT crash data by email request only
no published data dictionary for the extract (layout inferred from a consultant copy)
user_actions: Email Marsha.K.Mays@wv.gov (WVDOT Traffic Accident Data) for a statewide 2021-2025 crash extract with vehicle and person tables, the data dictionary, latitude/longitude and the county-based route ID + milepost; ask for CSV.
Ask in the same email whether the extract may be used in a paid engineering tool, and whether WVDOT will publish an open crash layer.
Send one delivered file (one county, one year is enough) so the column map can be checked and a reader built.
